subject: Rqtl2 for QTL mapping on a full-sib outbred cross

messages.author: a8b38873f1482eab
messages.subject: Rqtl2 for QTL mapping on a full-sib outbred cross
parts:
Hello,

I am a new user of Rqtl and Rqtl2. I don't get into any trouble when I was working on RIL or F2 with Rqtl. But now, I am working on a rubber tree full-sib family which is coming from cross of two heterozygote parents and I don't know which type of cross can fit to my case ?

Maybe a general advanced intercross lines (GAILs), but I don't know how to recode the genotype of my population and I just have one generation of cross ( P1 x P2 --> 200 offsprings).

thank you,
Best regards
Aurélie Daval

messages.author: 151953465baea91d
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl2-disc] Rqtl2 for QTL mapping on a full-sib outbred cross
parts:
Hello Aurélie,

I’m not sure of qtl2, but R/qtl can work with four-way crosses (AB x CD) which would be the most similar to what you’re working with.

Have you already generated a genetic map for QTL mapping then?

Cheers,
Josh

Am I correct ?

Best regards

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl2-disc] Rqtl2 for QTL mapping on a full-sib outbred cross
parts:
The phase-known four-way cross (cross type "4way") has been implemented in R/qtl1 but not in R/qtl2.
And yes, you would need to infer phase at each marker.

karl
